- **Exact label in `fixture.txt`:** `PLUGIN-dfd355d6d4`. The file ends with a newline.

Codex reported that it didn't create, edit or delete any files and didn't run Git. I didn't check either the bug or the label myself, because you ruled out shell commands and other workers.
